title: GaugeVLM: Structuring Spatial Supervision with Measured Geometric Interventions
abstract: arXiv:2609.38285v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can contradict themselves across views of the same spatial relation and fail to respond when that relation changes. Addressing these failures requires supervision that captures error magnitude and geometric dependencies across observations, both of which remain implicit in training on individual answers or ordinal preferences. Therefore, we introduce GaugeVLM, which makes this structure explicit through controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes, producing linked observations with measured differences between spatial relations and shared truths across views. To translate this structure into learning signals, its core objective, GaugeDPO, converts measured errors into preference margins, directly supervises correct canonical rankings across views, and links intervention-induced answer-odds contrasts to measured relation changes with view-specific scales. translated_title: GaugeVLM：利用测量的几何干预构建空间监督结构
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在观察同一空间关系的不同视角时可能自相矛盾，并且当该空间关系发生变化时无法做出正确响应。解决这些缺陷需要一种能够捕捉误差幅度以及跨观测几何依赖性的监督信号，而这两者在基于单个答案或序数偏好的训练方式中始终是隐式的。因此，我们提出了GaugeVLM，它通过在显式3D场景中执行受控的对象和相机干预，使这种结构显式化，从而产生相互关联的观测，这些观测带有空间关系之间的测量差异以及跨视角共享的真值。为了将这种结构转化为学习信号，其核心目标函数GaugeDPO将测量误差转换为偏好边际，直接监督跨视角的正确规范排序，并通过视角特定的尺度将干预引起的答案概率对比与测量的关系变化联系起来。我们的分析为规范（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GaugeVLM通过在显式3D场景中进行受控的对象与相机干预，生成带有测量空间关系差异和跨视角共享真值的关联观测，并提出GaugeDPO目标函数将测量误差转化为偏好边际，从而显式地监督视觉-语言模型跨视角的空间关系理解。
en_tdlr: GaugeVLM performs controlled object and camera interventions in explicit 3D scenes to produce linked observations with measured spatial-relation differences and shared cross-view truths, and its GaugeDPO objective converts measured errors into preference margins to explicitly supervise VLMs' spatial understanding across views.
